why.B1.1: Similar evidence as B4.1, but with a slightly lower local score, indicating a strong match for Systemic Lupus Erythematosus within the Autoimmune Disorder family
why.B2.1: Although Systemic Lupus Erythematosus can present with similar symptoms, the local score is lower, and the parent label is Infectious Disorder, which is less likely given the serologic tests and other evidence
why.B3.1: The lowest local score among the champions, with a parent label of Neoplastic Disorder, which is not supported by the evidence of high titers of ANA, anti-double-stranded DNA, and anti-Smith antibodies
why.B4.1: High titers of ANA, anti-double-stranded DNA, and anti-Smith antibodies, along with low complement C3 levels and non-anion gap metabolic acidosis with hyperkalemia, are characteristic of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus, which is a Connective Tissue Disorder
